qualification.details: Eminent scholar with Ph.D in Food Science and Nutrition/ relevant discipline. Actively engaged in research with a minimum of 10 publications in national/international journals with high impact factor. A minimum of 15 years of teaching experience in University/college and/or experience in research at University/National level institutions/industries, including experience in guiding students for research at doctoral level. Contribution to educational innovations, designing new curriculum and courses, and experience in technology mediated teaching-learning processes.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Co-Ordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the MGU Co-Ordinator post is 05 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Co-Ordinator post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Ph.D. in Food Science and Nutrition or a relevant discipline, along with a minimum of 10 publications and 15 years of teaching/research experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the MGU Co-Ordinator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Co-Ordinator position is 70 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Co-Ordinator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month for the Co-Ordinator position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the MGU Co-Ordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Co-Ordinator post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Co-Ordinator post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Co-Ordinator post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Co-Ordinator post in Mahatma Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Mahatma Gandhi University, www.mgu.ac.in.
